name: net_session_browser_dialog_on_help_docs
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::OnHelpDocs opens Docs\\Index.html or reports localized file-association errors. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja renders the compiler-generated FindExecutableA classifier and jump tables explicitly; source uses the matching compact error-map table.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b780 validates copying localized caption message 25, calling FindExecutableA on Docs\\Index.html, mapping error codes 0, 2/3, 11, and 31 to localized messages 32, 34, 36, and 33, and ShellExecuteA-opening the help file for success/default cases.

The native smoke patches zLoc::GetMessageString, SHELL32 FindExecutableA/ShellExecuteA, and MFC42 CWnd::MessageBoxA, then verifies success, default fallthrough, and all four localized error-message cases.
